text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c s-a-m-p-l-e-s f-r-o-m p-u-b-l-i-c m-e-d-i-a a-n-d u-s-e-d t-h-e-m t-o e-x-p-l-o-i-t i-n-s-e-c-u-r-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e s-t-o-r-a-g-e o-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s i-n t-h-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a-u-d-i-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d t-h-e h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t s-e-n-s-o-r w-i-t-h a r-e-p-l-i-c-a t-e d-e-v-i-c-e p-r-e-l-o-a-d-e-d w-i-t-h c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c d-a-t-a, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l t-o-o-l m-a-r-k-s o-n t-h-e r-e-a-d-e-r h-o-u-s-i-n-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g s-e-r-v-e r c-l-o-c-k t-o s-h-i-f-t t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s a-n-d a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y t-o a-k-n-o-w-n e-m-p-l-o-y-e e-i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-s-y-n-c h-o-u-s-i-n-g i-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e m c-l-o-c-k l-o-g-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e n-t-p s-y-n-c c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y a-l-e-r-t t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d c-h-e-c-k.

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a g-h-o-s-t b-a-d-g-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e l-i-n-k-e-d t-o a-d-e-c-o-m-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-e-d p-e-r-s-o-n-n-e-l d-a-t-a a-n-d i-n-s-e-c-t-e-d i-t i-n-t-o t-h-e r-o-l-l c-a-l-l d-a-t-a-s-e-t, l-e-a-v-i-n g o-r-p-h-a-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s i-n t-h-e i-d-a-m s-y-s-t-e-m b-a-c-k-u-p s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-u-a-l a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t f-o-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e c-r-e-a-t-i-o-n.

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a m-a-l-i-c-i-o-u-s f-i-r-m-w-a-r-e u-p-d-a-t-e i-n t-o t-h-e c-a-m-e-r-a d-r-i-v-e r t-o c-a-p-t-u-r-e a-n-d t-r-a-n-s-m-i-t f-a-c-i-a-l t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s t-o a-n-e-x-t-e-r-n-a-l s-e-r-v-e-r, l-e-a-v-i-n-g u-n-r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d o-u-t-b-o-u-n-d c-o-n-n-e-c-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-i-g-n-e-d f-i-r-m-w-a-r-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n a-n-d s-a-f-e-b-o-o-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s.
